headline: MTN Ghana 9M 2026 Service Revenue Rises 33.5% on Digital Adoption
summary: MTN Ghana reported a 33.5% increase in service revenue to GHS 23.2 billion for the first nine months of 2026, driven by mobile data and digital services. Profit after tax jumped 43% to GHS 7.8 billion.
why: MTN Ghana is a major telecommunications provider in West Africa, and its financial results offer insights into consumer spending and digital adoption trends in the region.

impacts.name: MTN Ghana
impacts.why: Strong earnings growth directly reflects positive financial performance for the company.
